description: Tracks the dynamic lifecycle and progress of a CurationTask.

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the associated curation task.

state.description: The current state of the task in its lifecycle.

executionDetails.description: Task-type-specific execution details. Null if no execution details are available.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The principal ID of the user who last updated the status.

lastUpdatedOn.description: Timestamp of when the status was last updated.

dueDate.description: Timestamp by which the task should be completed. Null if no due date has been set.

etag.description: Optimistic concurrency control token for the task status.
